title: Grand Prize Winner: Winning the Tuek Som Garage project with TaladHub innovation
image1Description: A moment of pride receiving the Grand Prize from the executive committee in the Tuek Som Garage project

section1.heading: Ultimate Success: From Idea to Real Business
section1.content: Starting from over 130 ideas across the entire corporate group, I led 'TaladHub' to the highest point by winning the Grand Prize in the Tuek Som Garage project. This success was born from integrating all my experiences—from deep-dive field research to developing a functional MVP and establishing a sustainable business model—to comprehensively meet the needs of the corporate group and the market management industry.

section2.heading: Role on the Final Pitching Stage
section2.content: As the Founder, Product Owner, and Main Pitcher, I had the honor of presenting our vision to the C-Suite Executives. I demonstrated the live Product Demo and presented solutions that sharply addressed key Pain Points, alongside a revenue generation and business expansion strategy based on the Business Model Canvas. I successfully proved the project's potential and investment value, winning over the committee to ultimately be selected as the number one team.

section3.heading: The Journey Continues: Moving Toward Commercialization
section3.content: This Grand Prize is not the end, but the beginning of bringing TaladHub into full-scale Commercialization. I have been granted the opportunity by the corporate group to further develop the product for industrial-level use, customer acquisition, and business operations according to the roadmap. I am committed to evolving this platform into a key driver for innovation and continuously creating new value for the organization.

section4.heading: Pride and Key Learnings
section4.content: This journey taught me that world-changing innovation must start with listening and relentless action. I am proud not only of the award but of building a strong team and a product that can truly help people in society. This experience has shaped me into an innovation leader ready to confidently face new challenges in the world of technology business.
